correctness.rationale: The 2-adic stationary model is justified by density-one cylinder approximations. Conditional parity yields C(h)=0 at odd lags and C(h)=[(-1)^{h/2}+C(h/2)]/2 at even lags. Valuation conditioning removes all lower-valuation contributions to the cubic expectation and scales the remainder by 2^{-m}. A signed pair integral R(q) vanishes for odd q and equals [C(q/2)-(-1)^{q/2}]/2 for even q, giving the stated r=1, r=2, and r>=3 coefficients. The Walsh formula and f(-x)=-f(x) prove the complete joint distribution and time asymmetry. The extracted verifier independently checks 767 exact rational residue comparisons with rigorously bounded exceptional-residue error; no finite calculation is used to justify the all-lag theorem.
